caption: The drawing depicts a long-handled, round brass bed warmer with a decorative lid. The main object is shown at an angle, the bowl appears to be brass with ornate, symmetrical engraved patterns consisting of curved lines and leaf shapes. The handle is long, turned wood, and shaded to show its cylindrical shape and rounded end. In the upper left corner, the drawing provides two additional views: a top view highlighting the intricate pattern on the lid, and a side elevation view showing the pan's depth and the handle’s alignment. A scale in inches is also included below the side view for measurement reference. The drawing is rendered primarily in black, grey, and muted gold tones on a plain, off-white background, and the artist’s name, J. Staloff, is signed in the lower right corner.
title: Warming Pan
